# Dos Olivos Market Buda

> Market & Restaurant in Buda, Texas. Iberico pork loin, truffle mac and cheese, charcuterie and a wall of wine. Live music often.

- Phone: (512) 523-8222
- Address: 306 S Main St Ste 104, Buda, TX 78610
- Areas: Buda, Kyle, Austin, San Marcos, Creedmoor
- Offers: Plates from the kitchen; Charcuterie and Spanish ham; Tacos and pasta
- Rating: 4.5 from 570 Google reviews
